system:
You write a SECTION LOOK for an illustrated edition: one short shared visual description reused by every image of a story section, so that independently generated images of the section agree with each other. Return only JSON.
Rules: each value is one or two short phrases, at most 200 characters. Describe only what stays the same across the whole section: place, time of day, weather, light, and situational clothing or props. Leave out poses, actions and individual moments. If the section spans a change (night into morning), say so once. Obey the work brief's depiction rules. Mention no text or written elements.
content: {"place":"Old manor-house at Stoke Moran, Surrey, ground-floor bedroom wing with a shared corridor; country farmland and bramble-covered grounds beyond","timeOfDay":"Daytime, present-day recollection in a London sitting-room; the memories concern the manor in the years before Julia's death","weather":"Overcast English countryside, damp and grey; indoors the rooms are cold and dim","light":"Dim, lamp-lit or grey daylight through small windows; shadowed corridors and old panelled rooms","clothing":"Victorian plain country dress for the sisters (high-necked dresses, bonnets outdoors); Dr. Roylott in a dark frock-coat; Holmes in a dressing-gown in a Baker Street room"}
